description: Get a summary of a project: canvas dimensions, per-clip summary (ids, indices, durations, element counts, voiceover_volume), and `audio_tracks` — every music/SFX entry on the project flattened to the same wire shape `add_audio` accepts (id, src, name, source_duration, guide_start_time/end_time, music_start_time/end_time, volume, loop, fade_in, fade_out). To copy an audio track to another project: read it from `audio_tracks` here and feed the same fields to `add_audio` on the target project. Call this to understand what's in the project before making changes. A clip whose voiceover this server is still generating carries `duration_pending: true` (with a top-level `durations_pending` note): its duration is the old value until the audio lands. get_clip says the same as `duration_pending` on any read that shows timings. Pass `render` to check the whole film in ONE image instead of the summary: {seams: true} every cut, {clips: true} one frame per clip (its middle; {clips: {at: 'start'|'middle'|'end'|<seconds>}} for another moment), {at: [film seconds]}. get_clip's filmstrip {seam: true} zooms into one cut.

render.description: The whole film as ONE labelled image instead of the summary: exactly one of seams, clips or at. A reply that leaves cuts or clips out names the next from_cut or from_clip.

at.description: Where in each clip (default 'middle'), or clip seconds.

clips.description: One frame per clip. 15 clips a call.

seams.description: Every cut: the last frame before it and the first after, labelled with its transition. 7 cuts a call.

name: get_project
title: Get project data
